budget_items.topic: A & D Crossroads permit fee and late fees
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The annual permit fee, non-compliance fee and daily late fee accrued while payment was late, leaving $950 due; Jimmy paid $4,500 instead of the $700 due, and the Commission reduced the late fee to $350.

budget_items.quote: deb added that they have agreements with other towns for so many hours per week, with excess hours billable, but lunenburg is not set up that way.
